data.name: The Westin Playa Vallarta, an All-Inclusive Resort
data.address: Av. Paseo de la Marina Sur 205, Marina Vallarta, 48354 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set on 6 palm-lined hectares overlooking Banderas Bay, this upscale resort is 1 km from Marina Vallarta.
Polished rooms feature TVs and Wi-Fi (fee), plus minibars, coffeemakers and balconies; most have ocean views. Club-level quarters provide access to a lounge with free breakfast. Suites add living rooms or 2nd stories. Room service is available 24/7.
A private beach has cabanas (fee), and a club with a steakhouse. There's also a restaurant with a rooftop terrace, and a lively lobby bar. Other amenities include 2 free-form outdoor pools (1 with a swim-up bar), a gym and a kids' club, plus sports courts, and a spa offering beachfront massages.
